CaraShellRoof_OB_108_1.message:
One loose corner is all it takes for a cover to end up down the road.
Ours has straps on all four sides, 8 ft long and adjustable to your rig, that clip into a hook at the bottom edge.
Two extra ratchet straps, 34 ft, come included at no extra cost.
The roof is the surface you never see, and the one that costs the most to repair.
$199 (was $249), save $50 (20%).
